token: fresh UUID generated by the builder; the placeholder is not an actual run identity

sampling.accounting: Sample the entire own runRoot once as one recursive domain, including work/spec/dist/caches/tmp/generated/licenses/provenance/binding/all raw streams and receipts; do not sum child domains again.
sampling.strategyOwner: I05 owns actual before/after sampling and monitoring policy and receipts.
sampling.evidenceMeaning: A machine mapping and external policy only; no sample, actual UUID, measured size, execution receipt or physical capacity proof is asserted.
sampling.scope: entire own runRoot and all descendants as one accounting domain
sampling.thresholdMeaning: External caller accounting threshold; I05 controller implements sampling, monitoring and over-threshold refusal. T03 builder does not enforce this threshold or a hard quota.

executionGuard.implementation: This contract defines the required external guard; the four-path source change does not implement OS hard limits or authorize actual build/OS execution.
